source: Audit of the plan and the console, 24 Oct 2026: the actions of actions17.json that the plan ties to the weather, and plan section 6.1. The wording of every action is read from actions17.json at each run; this file only says when the weather asks for it.
status: Verified that each action's own text names the weather link; the grouping by level is Proposed
notes: standing: due whatever the level is; watch: Enhanced watch, a rain level of watch; high: Pre deployment, a rain level of high or an NCM orange; red: Active response, an NCM red.
No action is tied to fog: the plan has no fog procedure (named gap, owner Waste Management with LOD). The fog measures are Proposed in interaction.json, never listed here as plan actions.
No figure is typed here. A detail such as a tranche size is read from the action text with the pattern shown.
